attorneys: Edmund G. Brown, Attorney General of California, Herbert E. Wenig, Assistant Attorney General, and Edward M. White for petitioner. Burke Williamson and Jack A. Williamson for Taylor et al., respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief, as amicus curiae.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
